tasks.label: debug: app + existing redis
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d redis && DEBUG_REDIS_HOST=redis DEBUG_REDIS_PORT=6379 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d --build app-debug && sleep 3

tasks.label: debug: app + clean redis
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d redis-debug && docker exec vsuet_rating_v2-debug-redis redis-cli FLUSHALL && DEBUG_REDIS_HOST=redis-debug DEBUG_REDIS_PORT=6379 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d --build app-debug && sleep 3

tasks.label: debug: nginx + app + clean redis
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d redis-debug && docker exec vsuet_rating_v2-debug-redis redis-cli FLUSHALL && DEBUG_REDIS_HOST=redis-debug DEBUG_REDIS_PORT=6379 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d --build app-debug nginx-debug && sleep 3
